title: SampledSmoothConvex.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of f(x)=Eξ[loss(ξ,x)]. Every sampled loss is convex and differentiable with L-Lipschitz gradient. A minimizer xstar exists with ‖x0−xstar‖≤R. Strong convexity is not required.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SampledSmoothConvex.lean: objective; spec.admissible, ConvexOn, HasGradientAt, gradient Lipschitz inequality, and minimizer clause.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each query x returns grad(ξ,x), the exact gradient of a sampled loss, using a fresh independent ξ with the hidden model's probability law. Replies contain only gradients. The sample-gradient expectation equals the objective gradient under the supplied smoothness and integrability conditions.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SampledSmoothConvex.lean: Model; spec.Query, spec.Reply; spec.admissible, infinitePi oracle law and answer.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Only the second moment at one minimizer is bounded: Eξ‖grad(ξ,xstar)‖²≤σ². No uniform variance or gradient-norm bound is assumed away from the minimizer; σ=0 is permitted.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SampledSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible, minimizer integrability and second-moment clauses; spec.valid.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is a second-countable complete real Hilbert space, potentially infinite-dimensional. Samples are independent and identically distributed. E, Ξ, L>0, R≥0, σ≥0, ε>0, and x0 are public; the sampling law, losses, gradients, and minimizer are hidden. Samplewise smoothness uses the same public L.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SampledSmoothConvex.lean: Params; Model; spec.Public, publicInput, valid, and admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The measurable output must have integrable objective gap f(output)−f(xstar), with expectation at most ε for an objective minimizer xstar.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SampledSmoothConvex.lean: spec.successful, minimizer, Integrable, and integral inequality.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Accuracy is in expectation over the output probability law. Oracle cost is a fixed worst-case call budget, not an expected stopping-time cost.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SampledSmoothConvex.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence, per-seed call-count inequality and product probability law.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: For some integer T, the output law must equal the law of xT from x{k+1}=xk−η(T−k)/T·grad(ξk,xk), where η=R/(8LR+σ√T) and ξk are independent samples. This is an exact terminal-iterate distribution requirement.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SampledSmoothConvex.lean: scale; path; spec.successful, equality of mapped probability measures.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The objective and sampled-gradient noise assumptions form an established stochastic convex optimization model, but success additionally requires the exact output distribution of a prescribed linearly decaying terminal-iterate trajectory.

descriptionHtml:
Linearly Decaying SGD for Sampled Losses

We minimize f(x)=Eξ∼ν[ℓ(ξ,x)] on a separable real Hilbert space E, where ν is a probability law on a measurable sample space Ξ and each sample loss ℓ(ξ,⋅) is convex with L-Lipschitz gradient, L>0. A given starting point x0 lies within distance R≥0 of a minimizer x⋆, where Eξ∼ν∥∇xℓ(ξ,x⋆)∥2≤σ2 for σ≥0. The oracle returns sample gradients using independent samples from ν. We analyze linearly decaying stochastic gradient descent (SGD), seeking a measurable last iterate x¯ with integrable objective gap satisfying E[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε, where ε>0 and expectation is over the samples.

The optimization problem is minx∈Ef(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E. The algorithm receives E, Ξ, L, R, σ, ε, and x0; the distribution ν and sample losses are accessed through the oracle.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Sample convexity and smoothness). For every ξ∈Ξ, the function ℓ(ξ,⋅):E→R is Fréchet differentiable. Write g(ξ,x)=∇xℓ(ξ,x). For every x,y∈E and t∈[0,1], ℓ(ξ,(1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)ℓ(ξ,x)+tℓ(ξ,y),∥g(ξ,x)−g(ξ,y)∥≤L∥x−y∥. The map g:Ξ×E→E is jointly measurable, and ℓ(⋅,x) is integrable under ν for every x∈E.

Assumption 2 (Initial distance and noise at a minimizer). There exists x⋆∈E such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈E,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R. The random variable ∥g(ξ,x⋆)∥2 is integrable under ν and satisfies Eξ∼ν[∥g(ξ,x⋆)∥2]≤σ2.

Queries may be made at any point of E. At call k, the oracle returns g(ξk,x) for the queried point x, where (ξk)k≥0 are measurable, mutually independent random variables with common law ν. Let P denote their joint law.

Our result is algorithm-specific: we analyze linearly decaying SGD. The method chooses a deterministic scale η≥0 and an integer T≥0 from the available inputs. Starting from the given x0, it performs ak={η(T−k)/T,T>0,0,T=0,xk+1=xk−akg(ξk,xk),k=0,…,N−1, where N≥0 is the allotted number of oracle calls. The tuning parameter T need not equal N. Each update uses one oracle reply, and the output is the last iterate x¯=xN, with x¯=x0 when N=0.

The output must be measurable under P, its objective gap must be integrable, and it must satisfy EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε.

comparisonHtml:
On a separable real Hilbert space, f(x)=∫Fξ(x)dp(ξ), where p is a probability measure, every Fξ is convex with L-Lipschitz gradient, the sample gradient is jointly measurable, and Fξ(x) is integrable for every x. A minimizer x⋆ satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R and ∫∥∇Fξ(x⋆)∥2dp(ξ)≤σ2. Here L,ε>0 and R,σ≥0. Samples are IID with law p under P. The setup restricts algorithms to linear-decay SGD; (1) uses known L,R,σ,T and guarantees the last-iterate target ∫[f(xT(ω))−f(x⋆)]dP(ω)≤ε. Costs count individual sample-gradient calls.

import LongTails.Template
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt
import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Gradient.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Function

namespace OracleTemplate.SampledConvex

noncomputable def scale (L R σ : ℝ) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  R / (8 * L * R + σ * Real.sqrt T)

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

noncomputable def path {Ξ : Type*} (grad : Ξ → E → E) (η : ℝ) (T : ℕ) (x0 : E)
    (ξ : ℕ → Ξ) : ℕ → E
  | 0 => x0
  | k + 1 => path grad η T x0 ξ k - (η * ((T : ℝ) - k) / T) • grad (ξ k) (path grad η T x0 ξ k)

noncomputable def linearDecaySgd (η : ℝ) (T : ℕ) (x0 : E) : Algorithm E E E where
  State := ℕ × E
  initial _ := (0, x0)
  query s := (0, s.2)
  update s g := (s.1 + 1, s.2 - (η * ((T : ℝ) - s.1) / T) • g)
  output s := s.2

end OracleTemplate.SampledConvex

open MeasureTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.SampledSmoothConvex

open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.SampledConvex

structure Params where
  E : Type u
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  [countableE : SecondCountableTopology E]
  Ξ : Type
  [measurableΞ : MeasurableSpace Ξ]
  L : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.linearE Params.completeE Params.measurableE Params.borelE
  Params.countableE Params.measurableΞ

structure Model (E Ξ : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ξ] where
  law : ProbabilityMeasure Ξ
  loss : Ξ → E → ℝ
  grad : Ξ → E → E

noncomputable def objective {E Ξ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ξ] (M : Model E Ξ) (x : E) : ℝ :=
  ∫ ξ, M.loss ξ x ∂(M.law : Measure Ξ)

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := Model p.E p.Ξ
  Query p := p.E
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  allowedAlgorithm q algorithm :=
    ∃ (η : ℝ) (T : ℕ), 0 ≤ η ∧ algorithm = linearDecaySgd η T q.x0
  publicInput p := p
  valid q := 0 < q.L ∧ 0 ≤ q.R ∧ 0 ≤ q.σ ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q M O :=
    ∃ P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ξ),
    LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ξ) => ξ k)
      (M.law : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
    O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ξ
          law := P
          answer := fun _ (_, x) ξ => M.grad ξ x } ∧
    Measurable (Function.uncurry M.grad) ∧
    (∀ ξ, ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (M.loss ξ)) ∧
    (∀ ξ x, HasGradientAt (M.loss ξ) (M.grad ξ x) x) ∧
    (∀ ξ x y, ‖M.grad ξ x - M.grad ξ y‖ ≤ q.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∀ x, Integrable (fun ξ => M.loss ξ x) (M.law : Measure q.Ξ)) ∧
    (∃ xstar, IsMinOn (objective M) Set.univ xstar ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ => ‖M.grad ξ xstar‖ ^ 2) (M.law : Measure q.Ξ) ∧
      ∫ ξ, ‖M.grad ξ xstar‖ ^ 2 ∂(M.law : Measure q.Ξ) ≤ q.σ ^ 2)
  successful q M output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn (objective M) Set.univ xstar ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => objective M (output ω) - objective M xstar) (P : Measure _) ∧
      ∫ ω, objective M (output ω) - objective M xstar ∂(P : Measure _) ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.SampledSmoothConvex
